description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for testing and mocking Telegram bot commands within the openclaw project, including creating deferred promises, command parameters, and message contexts.

methods.name: createDeferred
methods.description: Creates a deferred promise with external resolve function.

methods.name: createNativeCommandTestParams

methods.description: Creates a mock context for topic-based Telegram message commands.
